## Scope

Describe the user-facing change and any intentionally incomplete behavior.

## Exact-commit verification

- [ ] Formatting, analysis and Flutter tests
- [ ] SQL migrations and RLS/negative tests
- [ ] Edge type checking, tests and dependency audit
- [ ] Secret scan
- [ ] Native compile checks when app changes
- [ ] Relevant adversarial scenarios and regression tests

List failed, blocked and not-run checks explicitly. Draft status does not mean security approval.

## Release boundaries

No merge, deployment, credential creation or store release is implied by this PR. Attach real-device accessibility, network interruption and signed-build evidence separately before release approval.
